title: Band engineering of a PTAA hole transporting layer in the n–i–p architecture of MAPbI3-based perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00203F, Paper
Sachin A. Pawar, Abdurashid Mavlonov, Hiroki Mori, Yu Kawano, Kensuke Kojima, Jun Azuma, Takayuki Negami, Takashi Minemoto
This work reports the synthesis of poly[bis(4-phenyl)(2,4,6-trimethylphenyl)amine] (PTAA) with different chemical skeletal structures, resulting in varied highest occupied molecular orbital (HOMO) positions.
